vaccine-interval-validity.l: Date of the dose being checked (YYYY-MM-DD)
Minimum interval from the previous dose
Date of the most recent other live injectable or intranasal vaccine (YYYY-MM-DD)
Previous dose given the same day as a different live vaccine
A special grace period the schedule gives this dose

vaizey.l: Incontinence for solid stool (0 never to 4 daily)
Incontinence for liquid stool (0 never to 4 daily)
Incontinence for gas (0 never to 4 daily)
Alteration in lifestyle (0 never to 4 daily)
Need to wear a pad or plug (2 points if yes)
Taking constipating medicines (2 points if yes)
Lack of ability to defer defecation for 15 minutes (4 points if yes)

van-nuys-vnpi.l: Pathologic classification: 1 = non-high grade no necrosis, 2 = non-high grade with necrosis, 3 = high grade

vanc-auc.l: Peak draw time after infusion end
Trough draw time after infusion end
Current daily dose (optional; to revise it)

vanc-hd-dose.l: Dose given after dialysis or during it

vanc-initial-dose.l: Neonates: first week of life or later

vasi.l: Head and neck: involved area in HAND UNITS, where one unit is the patient's own palm including fingers and equals 1 percent of body surface area. Leave blank or 0 if not involved.

Head and neck: residual depigmentation. An ORDINAL LADDER chosen by description, not a free percentage [0 = No depigmentation; 10 = Only specks of depigmentation are present; 25 = The pigmented area exceeds the depigmented area; 50 = The depigmented and pigmented areas are equal; 75 = The depigmented area exceeds the pigmented area; 90 = Specks of pigment are present; 100 = No pigment is present]
